correctness.rationale: On the frozen RESULT.md, Dirichlet covariance (δ_ij−1/n)/[n(nα+1)] gives K(x,y)=−nα+n(nα+1)Σx_i y_i. K integrates to 1 and reproduces the affine span. Convexity of its negative part in x reduces the L∞ norm and positivity defect to a vertex, and interior-positive Dirichlet density makes nonvertex maxima strict. With Y_1~Beta(α,(n−1)α), the beta recurrence gives C=(nα+1)c^α(1−c)^b/[α B(α,b)]−I_c(α,b), hence both endpoint norms 1+2C and min_{0≤f≤1} Pf=−C. For α=λ/n, expanding the beta tail after splitting at c=λ/[n(1+λ)] proves λ−C=(λ²/n)[log n+1+log((1+λ)/λ)−ψ(λ)−γ]+o_λ(1/n). Fixed-α n→∞ uses gamma convergence and uniform integrability, fixed-n α→∞ Gaussian convergence; these regimes are distinct. Independently evaluated high-precision beta values for λ=.5,1,3 and n=300,3000; the claimed second-term errors decreased, but numerical checks are not proofs. Source check.py was inspected as exact-rational finite checker, not relied upon for the limiting theorem.
